verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents first-party self-hosting (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift with Helm charts) that runs the complete platform in your own infrastructure. That gives full control over where your data lives. The evidence does not show any region or residency choice in the hosted SaaS, so residency control comes only through self-hosting. missing for 10: region/residency selection for the managed cloud offering, explicit data-residency documentation (e.g. EU/US hosting options), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.
Kubernetes and OpenShift: Full Kubernetes deployment with Helm charts and operators
You can use Docker to set up an entire Flagsmith Feature Flag environment locally
